headline: Amphibian Bacterium Shows 100% Success Against Cancer in Rats
meta_description: Scientists discover a gut bacterium from amphibians that destroyed cancer cells with complete effectiveness in rat studies.
summary_short: Researchers have identified a bacterium from amphibian guts that proved 100% effective at destroying cancer cells during rat trials.
body:
Scientists have discovered a bacterium living in amphibian guts that destroyed cancer cells with complete effectiveness in rats, marking a striking breakthrough in the search for new cancer treatments.

The discovery emerged from the subreddit r/UpliftingNews, where the finding was shared by user Mamacrass. The research highlights how nature's smallest organisms—particularly those thriving in unexpected environments like amphibian digestive systems—may hold answers to some of medicine's greatest challenges.

While the current research involved animal models rather than human trials, the 100% effectiveness rate in destroying cancer cells offers genuine hope for future therapeutic development. The work underscores why scientists continue exploring diverse ecosystems for biological solutions to human disease.
